wins.label: Strong quarterly earnings
wins.evidence: the firm reported net income of $13 billion and EPS of $4.63 with an ROTCE of 18%

wins.label: Record client growth
wins.evidence: 1.7 million net new checking accounts, 10.4 million new card accounts and record households in wealth management

wins.label: Exceptional AWM flows
wins.evidence: Long-term net inflows were $52 billion for the quarter and $209 billion for the full year, positive across all channels, regions and asset classes

wins.label: Strong Markets performance
wins.evidence: Equities was up 40% with robust performance across the franchise, particularly in Prime

wins.label: Consumer resilience
wins.evidence: Consumers and small businesses remain resilient...debit and credit sales volume continued to perform well, up 7% year-on-year

risks.label: Credit card rate cap threat
risks.evidence: people will lose access to credit, like on a very, very extensive and broad basis...that would also be bad for us...this is a big business for us

risks.label: Stablecoin deposit risk
risks.evidence: creation of a parallel banking system that is sort of -- has all the features of banking...without sort of the associated prudential safeguards...clearly, there is some risk for some firms

risks.label: Geopolitical uncertainty
risks.evidence: Geopolitical is an enormous amount of risk...It's just a big amount of risk that may or may not be -- determine the state of the economy

risks.label: Elevated expense growth
risks.evidence: we expect 2026 adjusted expense to be about $105 billion...2026 in isolation clearly represents meaningful expense growth in both dollar and percentage terms

risks.label: Slower deposit growth
risks.evidence: our expectations for consumer deposit growth in 2026 are lower than they had been in our scenario analysis at Investor Day
